questions.stem: To find the upper bound of $\frac{a}{b}$, you should use:

options.text: Lower bound of $a$ divided by upper bound of $b$
Upper bound of $a$ divided by lower bound of $b$
Upper bound of $a$ divided by upper bound of $b$
Lower bound of $a$ divided by lower bound of $b$

questions.explanation: To maximise a fraction, make the numerator as large as possible and the denominator as small as possible. So use the upper bound of $a$ and the lower bound of $b$.
